narrative: Ervin Sarajevo contributed to the DAO's Build Game in strategy and user experience categories across eight activities in May 2022. His efforts focused on independently reiterating signals linked to pending decisions (three contributions), reviewing proposed strategies with cautions (two) and a specific improvement suggestion (one), providing reference material via link (one), and validating a user behavior (one). A notable accomplishment was his targeted feedback that highlighted areas to watch in strategy proposals.
